newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: INSIGHT - Most Dutch chartists positive on AEX.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Most Dutch chartists positive on AEX.

text.p: Dutch chartists said the outlook for the Dutch AEX share index was again buoyant, with only one contributor predicting a sideways pattern.
"For the coming week we expect at least some consolidation within the current rally," said Rabo Securities.
Other chartists said it was still a market to be long on, with ABN AMRO adding that investors should buy on weakness.
The inflow of liquidity was still strong. "The rising trend has been supported by positive money flow," said ING Barings.
The AEX share index slipped just over 3 points on Monday afternoon to about 859.
Last week the main index ended at 862.20 points on Friday, 16.11 points above the previous Friday. The AEX has gained 32 percent since the beginning of this year.
Contributor Trend Pvs view Support Resistance
Rabo Secs Neutral Up 839 834 n.a. n.a.

ING Barings - The uptrend is still intact, though shows some minor divergencies. The rising trend has been supported by positive money flow, indicating strong buying. The Advance/Decline lines of the AEX remain extremely bullish with new highs every week, indicating strong internal leadership. We hold on to our buy rating as long as short term uptrend around 850 remains intact.

Rabo Securities - Together with reaching the price-target at 860 the AEX index also touched the rising resistance line which marks the upper boundary of the rising channel. For the coming week we expect at least some consolidation within the current rally. Declines are not likely to drop below 825 where trendline support can be found.

ABN AMRO - This is still a long market. We expect some hesistation around 860. However, don't focus on the short side, but buy on weakness. Only a break below 835 will cause problems for the intermediate term uptrend.
